The Javelin was notable for some very close handicapping, four men being covered by just over a foot. Nowak was the winner, Bankhead, a newcomer, second, and Mickly Walker showed versatility by taking third prize.

They helped to keep things going in the form of impromptu wisecracks, Bert Footer and Percy Wright being to the fore in this respect. That they had a thoroughly enjoyable evening was obvious to any one present, Mickey Walker's laugh being as infectious as ever.
